sources: recreation.gov public campsite search API for facility 10003401 (17 sites)

values.note: All 17 sites are reservable on recreation.gov. 14-day limit within a rolling 30 days; sites must be occupied each night and no-shows are cancelled after the third night. Check-in 5 pm, check-out 4 pm.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10003401 (rules maxStay 14 days 'Rolling 30 Days', maxConsecutiveStay 14; notices 'No show reservations are subject to cancellation after the third night', 'Campsites must be occupied each night', 'Check in time is 5pm. Check out time is 4pm.') + site search (17 of 17 sites reservable), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov peak-season rate $10 per standard site (2026 peak season May 1 - Sept 13).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10003401/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-01 to 2026-09-13, PeakStandardCampsite $10; same for 2027-2028), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov public campsite search API for facility 10003401 (all 17 sites typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov per-site max vehicle lengths run 20-100 ft (16 of 17 sites list 30 ft or more; four list 100 ft, which look like pad lengths); no campground-wide limit is stated. RVs, vehicles and trailers must stay on the gravel/pavement.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10003401 ('Jo Bonner Campground has 17 designated campsites') + site search (per-site max vehicle length 20, 30, 32, 37x2, 47x3, 50, 57x2, 67, 90, 100x4), read 2026-10-22

values.note: In the recreation season: two vault toilets, potable water, a trash dumpster and a campground host. Gravel boat launch with a courtesy dock just outside the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10003401 ('During the recreation season facilities at Jo Bonner campground include two vault toilets, potable water, trash dumpster, and a campground host. There is a gravel boat launch with a courtesty dock'; amenity 'Drinking Water (peak season)'), read 2026-10-22

note: Small Bureau of Reclamation campground (run by Reclamation's Canyon Ferry Field Office) at the northeast end of Canyon Ferry Reservoir, about 30 miles east of Helena, off East Shore Drive. recreation.gov says it offers year-round access. Boating, swimming, fishing and ice fishing on the reservoir. --Claude
summary: rec.gov record + catalog: confirmed $10 (2026 peak season), 17 reservable sites on recreation.gov, no electric; added 14-day (rolling 30) limit, two vault toilets and potable water in season, host. Cleared max_rig_ft 100 (derived from the catalog's 100-ft pad lengths; per-site lengths run 20-100 ft). Season not recorded: rec.gov says only 'year-round access' and rate seasons are not campground seasons. Water/sewer (derived none) left; the catalog does not type them.
flags: Missing agency website: Reclamation's Canyon Ferry Reservoir page https://www.usbr.gov/gp/mtao/canyonferry/ (Canyon Ferry Field Office, (406) 475-3921). recreation.gov also says 'For facility specific information, please call (406) 475-3920'; the entry's 406-475-3921 is the field office.
